an1.21:1.1: The mind “developed” by way of the absorptions is “workable” ([an3.58:5.1]()), but it is “unworkable” due to the five hindrances ([sn46.33]()).| This chapter breaks from the previous pattern, in that it is not produced from a set of five.
an1.25:1.1: Here, _pātubhūta_ (“manifested”) is a synonym for “developed”, in reference to the realization of untapped potential. [an4.162]() speaks of the degree of manifestation of the faculties.
